title: HELIX Terminology: Financial Aid Award Type
description: Standard types of financial aid awards. Used by the FinAidAward resource 'award_type' attribute.

codes.definition: Gift aid that does not need to be repaid (e.g., Pell Grant)
Merit- or criteria-based gift aid that does not need to be repaid
Need-based loan where the government pays interest while student is enrolled
Non-need-based loan where interest accrues from disbursement
Federal loan for parents of dependent undergrads or graduate/professional students
Loan from a private lender, not part of federal programs
Earnings from a federally or institutionally funded part-time employment program
Full or partial waiver of tuition or fees
Financial support for graduate students, typically for research or academic merit
Graduate teaching or research assistantship with stipend and/or tuition remission
An award type not covered by the standard codes
